title: Heart Sutra 4 San Miguel de Allende
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: Here is a summary of the Soto Zen dharma talk in 4-6 sentences: Our bodies are not isolated entities, but complex ecosystems that rely on trillions of microorganisms to function properly. This realization challenges our traditional notions of self and encourages us to reevaluate our place within the world. By acknowledging the interconnectedness of all living beings, we can begin to let go of our attachment to external sources of happiness and fulfillment. This shift in perspective allows us to cultivate a deeper understanding of ourselves and others, and to approach life with greater compassion and awareness.
